title: Dijon Chicken with Leeks, Mushrooms & Rosemary Roast Potatoes
description: Seared chicken breast in a white wine, Dijon and crème fraîche sauce with soft leeks and browned mushrooms, served with crisp rosemary potatoes.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, the rosemary and 1 tsp salt on a lined tray. Roast 40 min, turning once at the 20-min mark, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Prep the chicken
steps.text: Slice each chicken breast horizontally into two thinner cutlets (about 1.5 cm thick) so they cook evenly. Pat dry and season with ½ tsp salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: With about 20 min left on the potatoes, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 4–5 min per side until golden and cooked through (no pink in the middle). Move to a plate.

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms and leeks
steps.text: Lower to medium, add the butter to the same pan, then the mushrooms. Fry 4 min until browned. Add the leeks and thyme and cook another 4 min until the leeks are soft.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Pour in the wine and let it bubble 2 min, scraping up the browned bits. Add the stock, crème fraîche and Dijon, stir smooth and simmer 3 min until lightly thickened. Return the chicken and any juices and simmer 2 min to heat through. Remove the thyme stalks.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Matthias: ≈400 g of the chicken (raw weight, about two-thirds of the cutlets), 70% of the sauce and ≈500 g of the potatoes. Partner: the remaining chicken, sauce and potatoes.

notes: Kifli swaps: if crème fraîche is out, use 120 ml 20% cooking cream (főzőtejszín). Swap the wine for extra stock if you prefer.
